title: Delivery and On-Site Service Terms of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
**Delivery.** Delivery is charged at the delivery fee printed against the service level for each order delivered inside the delivery radius printed against the same service level, and a site beyond that radius is quoted separately before the order is accepted.

**Service charge.** The service charge printed against the service level is applied to food and beverage on the order and never to the delivery fee, the rush surcharge or rented equipment.

**On-site hours.** The on-site service hours printed against the service level are included in the order; hours beyond that are billed at the additional service hour rate printed against the same service level, counted in whole hours and rounded up.

**Appointments.** Where china, linen or set-down is included at the service level, no separate charge is raised for it; where it is not included and the client asks for it, the order is moved up to the service level that includes it rather than charged as an extra.

**Clearing.** The team returns to clear within the clean-up window printed against the service level, and equipment left beyond that window is treated as rented equipment from the following day.

**Rented equipment.** Rented service equipment is held against the deposit printed against the service level, and equipment returned late carries the daily late return charge printed against the same service level.

**Licensed beverage service.** Licensed beverage service is only delivered on a service level that permits it, and an order that includes alcohol on a service level that does not is delivered without the alcohol.

### Illustration of the hour count

On a hypothetical order under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement whose service level carries 3.0 included on-site service hours, a team on site for four hours and ten minutes has served one hour and ten minutes beyond the included hours; counted in whole hours and rounded up, that is 2 additional hours, billed at the additional service hour rate printed against that level.
